title: HOLE UP GAMERS
synopsis: In the near future, the full-dive VR game "Visions" is popular in Japan. However, the game has a flaw, and players who exploit it by staying logged in for extended periods are dying. An attempt is made to log all players out to stop the game, but some players rebel. In order to bring the players who have barricaded themselves in the game back to reality, the protagonist, Kokoro Hato, who works in the community welfare department's hikikomori (social withdrawal) countermeasures office, travels to the world of "Visions" and makes contact with the players...? (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Erio & the Electric Doll
synopsis: The war between humanity and AI, which began a hundred years ago, came to an end when humanity chose to abandon electricity. In a world that has lost electric power, the last electric automaton, Ange, and the human girl she raised, Erio, set out on a steampunk adventure in a future not far from our own. (Source: MANGA MILLION)

title: Mimi's Tales of Terror
synonyms: Las historias de fantasmas de Mimi
synopsis: University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto encounter one chilling mystery after another. There’s the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she’s so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi’s movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day? Nine scary stories that really happened, drawn from the famed collection of urban legends Shin Mimibukuro (New Earmuffs), and adapted into manga by horror genius Junji Ito! Chapter 1: On the Utility Pole Chapter 2: The Woman Next Door Chapter 3: Rustling in the Grass Chapter 4: Grave Placement Chapter 5: Seashore Chapter 6: Just the Two of Us Chapter 7: Scarlet Circle Chapter 8: Sign in the Field Chapter 9: Monster Prop (Source: VIZ Media)
